title: The Starched Collar on the Chair
youtube_title: The Starched Collar on the Chair | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Some good things arrive only when they are not poked.
summary: At a greenhouse bench with seed pots and a south window, Lior wants to check on a small collar left to let the starch settle before it is ready. With Auntie June nearby, Lior leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
